title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About the role:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to design, train and deploy predictive models used by millions of users.
Responsibilities:
- Build end-to-end ML pipelines from data collection to model deployment.
- Perform feature engineering and model evaluation on large datasets.
- Collaborate with product teams to turn business problems into ML solutions.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience in machine learning.
- Strong Python skills with Scikit-learn, Pandas and NumPy.
- Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Solid understanding of statistics and data structures and algorithms.
- Experience with SQL and Git.
Nice to have:
- MLOps experience with MLflow, Docker or Kubernetes.
- Cloud experience on AWS or Google Cloud.

title: NLP Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop text classification, named entity recognition and semantic search systems.
- Fine-tune Transformer models (BERT, sentence transformers) for domain-specific language tasks.
- Build retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using large language models.
Requirements:
- Strong background in natural language processing and deep learning.
- Hands-on experience with Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy or NLTK.
- Proficiency in Python and PyTorch.
- 1+ years of experience building NLP applications.
Preferred:
- Experience with vector databases, FastAPI and Docker.
- Publications or Kaggle competitions in text mining.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We need a Data Analyst who turns raw sales data into clear business insights.
Key Responsibilities:
- Clean, transform and analyse data from multiple sources.
- Build interactive dashboards and reports for management.
- Perform exploratory data analysis and present findings to stakeholders.
Requirements:
- Advanced SQL and Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP).
- Experience with Power BI or Tableau.
- Good knowledge of statistics.
- Strong communication skills.
Good to have:
- Python (Pandas) for data analysis.
- Google Analytics experience.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop object detection and image classification models for retail shelf monitoring.
- Optimise models for edge devices.
Requirements:
- Experience in computer vision with OpenCV.
- Deep learning with PyTorch or TensorFlow; experience training CNNs.
- Strong Python and C++ skills.
- 2+ years of relevant experience.
Preferred:
- Experience with Docker and model deployment on embedded systems (Raspberry Pi, Jetson).

title: Python Backend Developer
description:
About the role:
Join our backend team to build scalable REST APIs for a SaaS platform.
Responsibilities:
- Design and implement RESTful services using Django and FastAPI.
- Write unit tests and participate in code reviews.
- Optimise PostgreSQL queries and caching with Redis.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of professional Python development.
- Experience with Django or Flask.
- Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL.
- Familiarity with Git and Linux.
Nice to have:
- Docker, Celery, AWS.
- Experience with microservices and message queues (RabbitMQ).

title: Junior Python Developer
description:
We are hiring fresh graduates who love Python.
Responsibilities:
- Write clean, maintainable Python code for internal automation tools.
- Build small web services with Flask.
- Write scripts to process CSV and Excel files.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
- Good understanding of Python and object-oriented programming.
- Basic knowledge of SQL and Git.
- Problem solving skills and willingness to learn.
Bonus:
- Knowledge of Pandas, REST APIs or Linux shell scripting.

title: Java Backend Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain microservices for core banking using Spring Boot.
- Design REST APIs and integrate with third-party payment gateways.
- Write unit tests with JUnit.
Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with Java (Java 11 or later) and Spring Boot.
- Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns and data structures.
- Experience with Oracle or MySQL databases.
- Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins).
Preferred:
- Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes.
- Experience in the banking or fintech domain.

title: Android Developer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain native Android applications.
- Integrate REST APIs and Firebase services.
Requirements:
- 1+ years of Android development experience.
- Proficiency in Kotlin and Java.
- Understanding of MVVM architecture.
- Experience with Git.
Nice to have:
- Flutter or React Native experience.
- Published apps on the Play Store.

title: .NET Developer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop enterprise web applications with ASP.NET Core and C#.
- Build Web APIs and integrate with Angular frontends.
- Write optimised T-SQL queries and stored procedures in SQL Server.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience with C#, .NET Core and Entity Framework.
- Experience with SQL Server.
- Understanding of OOP, SOLID principles and design patterns.
- Experience with Git.
Preferred:
- Angular or React experience.
- Azure DevOps, Docker, and microservices.
- Unit testing with xUnit or NUnit.

title: Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular)
description:
About the role:
We need a full stack engineer comfortable on both sides of the stack.
Responsibilities:
- Build responsive SPAs with Angular, TypeScript and RxJS.
- Develop backend services in ASP.NET Core Web API.
- Implement authentication with JWT and OAuth.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience with Angular and TypeScript.
- Experience with C# and .NET.
- SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
- HTML, CSS, Bootstrap.
Nice to have:
- SignalR, Redis, Azure.
- Experience with CI/CD.

title: Frontend Developer (React)
description:
Responsibilities:
- Build pixel-perfect, responsive user interfaces from Figma designs.
- Develop reusable components with React and Redux.
- Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs.
Requirements:
- 1+ years of experience with React.js and JavaScript (ES6+).
- Strong HTML5, CSS3 and responsive design.
- Experience with Git.
Preferred:
- TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS.
- Unit testing with Jest.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Conduct user research and create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs.
- Run usability testing sessions and iterate on feedback.
- Maintain the design system.
Requirements:
- Portfolio demonstrating UX design and visual design skills.
- Proficiency in Figma or Adobe XD.
- Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
- Strong communication and teamwork.
Nice to have:
- Basic HTML and CSS.

title: WordPress / Web Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative web designer.
Responsibilities:
- Design and develop websites for small businesses.
- Customise themes and ensure SEO best practices.
Requirements:
- Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery.
- PHP and MySQL basics.
- Graphic design skills with Photoshop.
Good to have:
- Bootstrap and SEO knowledge.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
- Manage containerised workloads on Kubernetes.
- Provision infrastructure as code with Terraform.
- Set up monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.
Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in DevOps or SRE roles.
- Strong Linux administration and Bash scripting.
- Hands-on with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Experience with AWS or Azure.
Preferred:
- Ansible, Python scripting, Nginx.

title: Cloud Engineer (Azure)
description:
Responsibilities:
- Design and operate cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure.
- Automate deployments with Azure DevOps pipelines and PowerShell.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of Azure experience.
- Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory and networking.
- Infrastructure as code (Terraform or ARM).
Nice to have:
- AZ-104 certification, Docker, Kubernetes.

title: Database Administrator
description:
Responsibilities:
- Administer, tune and back up production databases.
- Write and optimise complex queries and stored procedures.
- Ensure high availability and disaster recovery.
Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience as DBA with SQL Server or Oracle.
- Strong SQL, PL/SQL and database design skills.
- Experience with Linux.
Preferred:
- PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
- Experience with cloud databases on AWS or Azure.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Build reliable ETL/ELT data pipelines that ingest data from APIs and databases.
- Model data in the data warehouse for analytics.
- Orchestrate workflows with Apache Airflow.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience in data engineering.
- Strong Python and SQL.
- Experience with Apache Spark (PySpark).
- Data warehousing concepts (Snowflake, Redshift or BigQuery).
Nice to have:
- Kafka, Docker, dbt.
- AWS experience.

title: ETL Developer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain ETL processes using SSIS and Informatica.
- Data integration from multiple source systems into the enterprise data warehouse.
Requirements:
- Strong SQL and T-SQL.
- Experience with SQL Server and Oracle.
- Understanding of dimensional modeling and data warehousing.
Preferred:
- Power BI reporting, Python scripting.

title: Big Data Engineer (Hadoop)
description:
Responsibilities:
- Process large-scale datasets on the Hadoop ecosystem.
- Write Spark jobs in Scala and Python.
Requirements:
- Experience with Hadoop, HDFS, Hive and MapReduce.
- Apache Spark and Kafka.
- Scala or Java.
- Linux and shell scripting.
Preferred:
- Cloud data platforms (AWS EMR, Google Cloud Dataproc).

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Design and maintain automated test suites for web and mobile apps.
- Integrate tests into CI/CD.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of test automation experience with Selenium or Cypress.
- Programming in Java, Python or JavaScript.
- API testing with Postman.
- Understanding of Agile/Scrum.
Nice to have:
- Appium, JMeter performance testing, Playwright.

title: Software QA Engineer (Manual)
description:
Responsibilities:
- Write and execute test cases, perform functional and regression testing.
- Log and track defects in Jira.
Requirements:
- 1+ years of manual testing experience.
- Knowledge of SDLC, STLC and Agile.
- Basic SQL.
- Good communication skills.
Bonus:
- Exposure to automation testing and API testing.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Configure and monitor firewalls, VPNs and intrusion detection systems.
- Perform vulnerability assessments and respond to incidents.
Requirements:
- 2+ years of network security experience.
- Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, switching); CCNA.
- Experience with SIEM tools such as Splunk or QRadar.
- Linux.
Preferred:
- Penetration testing experience, CEH or OSCP certification.
- Python scripting.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Responsibilities:
- Develop and audit smart contracts on Ethereum.
- Build web3 frontends that interact with contracts.
Requirements:
- Experience with Solidity and smart contracts.
- JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js.
- Understanding of cryptography and blockchain fundamentals.
Preferred:
- React, Rust, security auditing experience.

title: SAP FICO Consultant
description:
Responsibilities:
- Configure and support SAP FI/CO modules.
- Gather business requirements and map them to SAP processes.
Requirements:
- 3+ years of SAP FICO implementation experience.
- Strong understanding of accounting, general ledger and financial reporting.
- Business analysis and stakeholder management.
Preferred:
- SAP S/4HANA certification.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Responsibilities:
- Elicit and document business requirements and user stories.
- Work with development teams in an Agile environment.
- Analyse data to support decisions and present to stakeholders.
Requirements:
- 2+ years as a business analyst.
- Requirements gathering, process modelling and BRD writing.
- SQL and Excel.
- Jira and Confluence.
- Excellent communication skills.
Nice to have:
- Power BI or Tableau.

title: Project Manager (IT)
description:
Responsibilities:
- Plan, execute and deliver software projects on time and within budget.
- Run sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
- Manage risks, scope and stakeholder communication.
Requirements:
- 4+ years of project management experience in IT.
- Agile/Scrum and Kanban.
- Jira, MS Project.
- Leadership and stakeholder management.
Preferred:
- PMP or PSM certification.

title: HR Executive
description:
Responsibilities:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment and onboarding.
- Maintain employee records and handle payroll coordination.
- Handle employee relations and engagement activities.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's in HR or Business Administration.
- 1+ years in human resources or talent acquisition.
- MS Excel and HRMS.
- Strong communication skills.
Nice to have:
- Knowledge of labour law.

title: Sales Executive (B2B)
description:
Responsibilities:
- Generate leads, meet clients and close B2B deals.
- Maintain the sales pipeline in CRM.
Requirements:
- 1+ years of sales or business development experience.
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
- Excel.
Preferred:
- Salesforce experience.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Responsibilities:
- Plan and run social media marketing and email marketing campaigns.
- Improve organic traffic through SEO.
- Track performance in Google Analytics.
Requirements:
- 1+ years of digital marketing experience.
- SEO/SEM and content marketing.
- Google Analytics.
Nice to have:
- Graphic design with Photoshop or Canva.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Responsibilities:
- Oversee daily warehouse and logistics operations.
- Optimise inventory management and procurement processes.
- Lead a team of supervisors.
Requirements:
- 5+ years in operations or supply chain management.
- Leadership and problem solving.
- ERP systems and Excel.
Preferred:
- SAP MM, Lean / Six Sigma certification.
